title: Schemes over a pushout sit in a category equivalence with pairs of schemes glued along the closed subscheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the category of schemes over a pushout with the category of pairs of schemes over the two factors glued along the image of the closed subscheme, which is the categorical content behind gluing along a closed immersion. The proof constructs the functor in one direction using the universal property of the pushout, constructs its inverse by gluing along the common closed subscheme, and then verifies the two composites are the respective identities; the verification that the glued object really carries the correct algebra structures is the step that cannot be skipped. Retained author proof at lines 4295-4346.
